versions.changelog: SEO/AEO/GEO-optimized docs: richer features, FAQ, comparison table, geo/local section, accurate CLI quick-start; README badges. No code changes.

Major v2.0.0 update with new features and streamlined workflow:

- Added multiple dithering modes (braille, block, greyscale)
- Introduced ANSI color output and framerate control
- New commands: terminal playback, palette modes, single-frame capture, video info, and self-test
- Removed all external dependencies; now works with Python standard library only
- CI integration support with new self-test and verification scripts
- Documentation significantly improved and updated for v2 features

Initial release of ASCII Video Converter.

- Convert video files to colored ASCII art animations (MP4 or GIF).
- Supports full ANSI color output and customizable settings (width, FPS, character set).
- Preview single video frames as ASCII art.
- Convert still images to ASCII.
- Requires Python 3.8+, Pillow, and ffmpeg.
